title: Receipt Calculator
prompt:
Implement `receipt(price, people)` so `program()` prints exactly:
`total: 26.4` (price times 1.1 tax, as a double)
`per person: 13.2` (total split between 2 people — real division!)
Both numbers must be doubles, printed with a single space after the label.

tests.name: taxed total
tests.hint: total = price * 1.1 — make sure the math is done in doubles.

tests.name: fair split
tests.hint: per person = total / people. If you divide integers you will get 13 instead of 13.2.
